name: Badge Battle Robe
description: Increase DEF of all allies by 25% in the next battle.
story:
A battle robe studded with Fluffy Across the Blue badges. Thanks to its exceptional defensive capabilities, it's become one of the most practical pieces of The Fluffy merch out there.
As a heavy suit of armor, wearing this battle robe does restrict your movement somewhat. Some fighters have developed "Badge Jujitsu" and "Badge War Dance" techniques to adapt their combat style when fighting in The Fluffy robes.

"Tomorrow's opponent is a hardcore fan of March Bunny. There are a few spots on your robe they'll absolutely refuse to hit. Remember that."
